result.title: Spectral Signatures of Memorization Basins in Diffusion Trajectories
result.summary: Diffusion models are known to reproduce individual examples from their training data as a form of memorization with implications for generalization, privacy, and downstream use. Recent work demonstrated that memorized training samples reside inside contiguous regions of the data/latent space known as basins of memorization -- once a denoising trajectory enters a basin, under finite perturbations it irreversibly reproduces a memorized example. Prior empirical work on such basins in trained models has primarily focused on classifier-free guidance based detection and mitigation strategies in text-to-image models, leaving basin entry and their formation largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we present a geometric characterization of memorization basins for conditional, unconditional, and rectified-flow-based diffusion models. We observe a characteristic signature in the local spectrum of the function geometry that distinguishes basin entry: the emergence of a dominant singular mode followed by a sharp spectral recovery. This signature appears at two timescales: along denoising trajectories during inference and over the course of training. We further investigate whether these geometric signatures can be used to intervene on memorization. During training, we suppress memorization by acting on the dominant mode. At inference, we develop methods to identify trajectories entering memorization basins and steer them away. We find that these interventions remain effective even with low-dimensional approximations of the underlying geometry, and demonstrate that geometry-informed steering extends to large-scale text-to-image diffusion models. Together, our results corroborate that local spectral geometry provides a common basis for characterizing memorization and for suppressing, detecting, and steering away from it across training and generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对条件、无条件及 rectified-flow 扩散模型的「记忆盆地」做几何刻画，发现轨迹进入盆地时局部谱几何会出现主导奇异模突起继而谱快速恢复的特征，并据此在训练期抑制记忆、在推理期检测并引导轨迹离开。
AI.relevance_reason: 其沿生成轨迹监测局部谱几何、识别状态进入某区域并施加干预的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态轨迹的行为模式检测与引导提供方法线索，但研究对象是图像生成中的记忆而非多模态推理，可迁移性需核查。
